item.title: CALL OF DUTY Movie Rumored Updates May Point To Mark Wahlberg Leading The Cast For Filmmaker Peter Berg
item.description: We have news on the upcoming Call of Duty movie from Taylor Sheridan and Peter Berg, including when shooting will begin and what era the story will be set in. Will Mark Wahlberg lead the cast, though?

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY - Will We Get Another Big "Chair Reveal" Cast Announcement? Here's The Latest
item.description: Fans are anticipating another Avengers: Doomsday "chair reveal" cast announcement from Marvel Studios in the buildup to the movie's release next year, but they may want to manage expectations...

item.title: PREDATOR: BADLANDS Passes Major Box Office Milestone, Sets New Franchise Record
item.description: Unlike the surprising Prey and the well-received animated feature Predator: Killer of Killers, Predator: Badlands was conceived from the start as a theatrical experience.

item.title: RUSH HOUR 4 Officially Coming From Paramount And Warner Bros. After Reported Interest From Donald Trump
item.description: Following claims that Donald Trump was interested in a continuation of the Rush Hour franchise, a fourth installment in the series has now been confirmed.

item.title: 5 Things To Expect From The Scorpion's Return In SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY
item.description: Spider-Man: Brand New Day is set to put Michael Mando's Mac Gargan/The Scorpion front and center, and we're now taking a deep dive into exactly what to expect from the villain's MCU return next summer...

item.title: AVATAR: FIRE AND ASH Director James Cameron Is Willing To Walk Away From The Franchise If Threequel Fails
item.description: Ahead of Avatar: Fire and Ash's release in theaters next month, filmmaker James Cameron has confirmed that he's willing to walk away from Avatar...and that he won't hand the franchise to another director.

item.title: Glen Powell Is Out To Kill His Family In New Trailer For HOW TO MAKE A KILLING
item.description: The first official trailer for Glen Powell's How to Make a Killing has landed online, offering a first look at the upcoming John Patton Ford-directed feature where Powell is out to kill his family.

item.title: STAR TREK: STARFLEET ACADEMY Still Reveals First Look At WWE Superstar Becky Lynch In Operations Gold
item.description: A new look at Star Trek: Starfleet Academy has been revealed, and the professional wrestling fans among you will be very excited to see the spotlight placed on WWE Superstar Becky Lynch. Check it out...
